definitions.explanation: Going out to catch fish or other seafood, especially as a fisherman's work. Mostly used in set phrases such as {漁|りょう}に{出|で}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{漁|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: My father goes out fishing early every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あ}れていた→荒れる：04577_areru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漁|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The sea was rough, so there was no fishing today.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漁|りょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out fishing
- {漁|りょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fish (for a living)
- {大漁|たいりょう}: a big catch
- {禁漁|きんりょう}: a fishing ban, closed season

PRONUNCIATION:
Alone, {漁|りょう}; in most compounds ぎょ (⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧, ⟦{漁船|ぎょせん}→漁船：22594_gyosen⟧, ⟦{漁村|ぎょそん}→漁村：31231_gyoson⟧), but りょう in ⟦{漁師|りょうし}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧ and {大漁|たいりょう}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧: fishing with a rod, including as a hobby; {漁|りょう} is fishing as a trade, usually with boats and nets
